articles.title: Agriculture Secretary’s Christian Messages to Staff Went ‘Too Far,’ Judge Says
articles.summary: A federal judge ordered limits on Brooke Rollins’s promotion of her religious beliefs, saying her emails to her department had violated the First Amendment.

articles.title: On-the-run female chemistry teacher arrested 70 miles away in Hampshire after dodging sentence for having sex with 14-year-old pupil up to 30 times
articles.summary: Police are hunting female chemistry teacher Sally-Anne Bowen who slept with a 14-year-old pupil up to 30 times and seduced another after she failed to turn up to court to be sentenced.

articles.title: Police arrest teacher who missed sentencing after indecent assault conviction
articles.summary: Sally-Anne Bowen was found guilty of having sexual relationships with two pupils at a boys’ school in the 1980s. articles.summary: Sarah Pochin was filmed in an undercover sting by ITV reporters saying colleagues excluded her because she was a woman.

articles.summary: As "Grand Theft Auto VI" launches, an expert links past "GTA" releases to teens citing the game before robberies, subway surfing and police impersonation.

articles.title: Nolte: China Bans Reporter from Summit for Shouting Question at Trump
articles.summary: A reporter from Bloomberg TV shouted a question at President Trump and was then banned by China from attending an event.

articles.title: China Bars Bloomberg Reporter From Trilateral Talks for Asking a Question
articles.summary: The exclusion of the reporter after she shouted a question to President Trump is an example of how tightly China tries to stage-manage events.
